mechanism: Perphenazine potentiates carvedilol's hypotensive and CNS depressant effects through additive alpha-adrenergic blockade and enhanced CNS depression, while both drugs may inhibit CYP2D6 metabolism.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, assess for orthostatic hypotension and excessive CNS depression; dose adjustments may be necessary; educate patient on fall prevention and dizziness management.
